text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Biko and Bono invited me to
hang out
again. If you're free, why don't
you come with us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since her last trip ended on a sour note,
I accept
her invite to keep an eye on the
situation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mm! The weather is so nice... It makes
me want to
take a nap on the grass.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, don't do that! We have to take a
better
picture with Carrot Ranger today
to make up for
last time, so let's go!

text_block_list.name: Carrot Ranger
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I remember you three from the
amusement
park. Sorry about the way
things turned out last
time! How's the
angle of my punch?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Carrot Ranger, could you... No, never
mind! Don't
worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just go ahead and give your best Carrot
Ranger
Punch with my friend, please!

text_block_list.name: Carrot Ranger
text_block_list.text:
All right. Here I go! Carrot Ranger
Puuuunch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So I heard that at this farm, you can
actually
make your own giant cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really?! Wow! That sounds so fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Chef
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. The giant cake workshop is

reservation only...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then shall we have a go at the regular
cake
workshop instead?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain it will be a lot of fun with all
of us
working on it together! Don't you
think,
Akebono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do that! Having fun making
tasty food
is the most buono thing
ever! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That was fun! Why don't we take
a break
here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when she was only focused on
being
dependable, she might've gotten
upset about
what happened, but it
seems she's fully enjoying
the day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's wrong, Trainer? You're
spacing out
hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Overdoing it? Oh. Right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... The old me would have been
trying to do
everything I could to seem
dependable.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But then I realized something, on that
day when I
hung out with Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Patients don't find doctors trustworthy
simply
based on what they say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What patients want is a doctor that will
take them
seriously and who genuinely
cares for their
well-being.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The same thing goes for the teacher we
saw in the
park, and the teacher who
taught me to make
sakura mochi. We
don't respect them because
they know
everything in the world.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We look up to them because they put
their
students first... And...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're the same too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've never expected life-changing advice
or
awe-inspiring quotes from you. Heck,
I never
even thought about what kind of

accomplishments you've garnered.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But when I'm stressed, you help me out,
and when
I'm on the verge of overdoing
things, you stop
me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Those are the actions that make me want
to chase
my dreams together with you...
Because I can tell
you care.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've realized that it's not a person's
words or even
their actions that really
matter—it's their
intentions!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And I think I can honestly say... my
intentions
have been good all along.
Even at the amusement
park, I was just
being considera—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O! Wanna play sumo tug-of-war
with a
bull?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sumo?! Count me in! I'll be the referee!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna head over! It's time to
continue my fun
day with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna head over! It's time to
continue my fun
day with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Of course! You have no idea how
many
times I played referee with my
dad!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This is what you might call "a fit more
perfect
than an Umamusume's signature
racewear!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Exactly! Okay, I'm going now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she leaves, I can't help but reflect on
how
much she's grown... Even her
proverbs make a
little sense now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gosh... Having someone I depend on
say that
to me makes my tail feel all
floofy and twitchy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-well, anyway! I'll see you later! Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she quickly runs off, I can't help but
think she's
grown a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What?! You too?! I'm not sure you'll be
able to
handle it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's not what you do, it's how you think,
huh?
Okay, sure! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that... I lose by a landslide to the
bull, but I
find it a very intense and
fulfilling challenge!
